facts.quote: Tech stocks plunged Friday morning, putting the Nasdaq 100 index on course for a more than $1 trillion drop.
facts.text: Major technology stocks wiped out over $1 trillion in market capitalization in a single trading session as investor skepticism mounted over surging artificial intelligence capital spending.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The ructions in tech and the artificial intelligence trade led to U.S. stocks largely posting a negative month, with the NASDAQ Composite in particular sliding more than 5% in October and notching its worst monthly performance since March 2025.
facts.text: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite dropped over 5% across October, registering its steepest monthly decline since March 2025.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The bulls trooped into the domestic equity market Thursday after two sessions as crude oil prices eased a little to the day's low of $113 a barrel.
facts.text: Global crude benchmarks hovered near $113 per barrel while the Indian rupee traded near 95 per dollar, elevating imported fuel costs.

facts.quote: Volkswagen reported an after-tax loss of €5.8 billion ($6.5 billion) for the July-September quarter on Thursday as a write-down on its Porsche stake and falling sales in China weighed on results.
facts.text: Volkswagen logged a $6.5 billion quarterly after-tax loss due to valuation impairments and contracting vehicle sales in China.

topic.summary: TOP 10 ROUNDUP. Plain everyday Hinglish a 15-year-old follows, one line per item (fact + why it matters), in this order, item 1 is the hook and title. Say 'reported' where marked. No tips. 1. Friday 30 Oct ko tech companies ke shares se about 1 trillion dollar, yaani lagbhag 95 lakh crore rupaye, ek din mein saaf (reported); wajah: AI par itna kharcha, kamaai kab? 2. Intel ka share about 29% gira, 1974 ke baad sabse bura din; agle quarter ki kamaai ka andaaza umeed se kaafi kam. 3. America ka Nasdaq poore October mein about 5% gira, March 2025 ke baad sabse bura mahina. 4. Crypto exchange Binance se about 6.3 billion dollar chori, itihaas ki sabse badi crypto chori; Bitcoin 77,000 dollar se neeche, withdrawals band. 5. Microsoft ne about 60,000 logon ko, yaani har chaar mein se ek, khud naukri chhodne ka offer diya, India ke kuch employees bhi shamil; paisa AI par lagana hai. 6. Amazon ka cloud business 39% badha, par AI kharche ke baad haath mein cash nahi bacha, share gira. 7. India mein sona do din mein about 5,000 rupaye sasta, 24 carat about 1.39 lakh rupaye per 10 gram (reported, city ke hisaab se alag). 8. Rupaya about 95 per dollar ke paas, aur kachcha tel about 113 dollar; matlab petrol-diesel aur import mehenga rehne ka darr. 9. DoorDash, America ki food delivery company, Instacart ko about 17 billion dollar mein khareedegi (reported deal). 10. Volkswagen ko ek quarter mein about 6.5 billion dollar ka nuksaan, China mein cars kam biki. Then the send line. Disclaimer line: yeh investment advice nahi hai. Category: markets.
